# Driveaway Auto Finance

> Driveaway Auto Finance is an independent used-car dealership with in-house financing at 2333 W 37th Ave, Hobart, IN 46342 (Lake County, northwest Indiana). Phone 219-945-3136. It sells used sedans, SUVs, trucks and minivans, buys and takes trade-ins on vehicles, and helps customers with limited or damaged credit find financing. Prices exclude taxes and fees and may change without notice; approval and terms depend on the customer's income, credit and the vehicle.

## Key pages

- [Inventory](https://abdallahbatah.github.io/driveaway-auto-finance/inventory/): All used vehicles currently for sale, with filters and a payment estimate
- [Financing](https://abdallahbatah.github.io/driveaway-auto-finance/financing/): Quick application and payment calculator
- [Sell or trade](https://abdallahbatah.github.io/driveaway-auto-finance/sell/): How selling or trading in a vehicle works
- [Car finder](https://abdallahbatah.github.io/driveaway-auto-finance/finder/): Describe the car you want and we search for it
- [Visit us](https://abdallahbatah.github.io/driveaway-auto-finance/visit/): Address, phone, what to bring
- [Reviews](https://abdallahbatah.github.io/driveaway-auto-finance/reviews/): Highlights from customer reviews
